blocks.text: JAKARTA, Indonesia — Indonesian rescuers searched Monday for 34 missing workers after a deadly fire swept through a candy facotry, west of Jakarta. Saturday’s fire broke out at the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia factory in Banten province.
